data.one_liner: Format and parse human‑readable durations in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides extension methods and functions to convert Duration objects to readable strings and to parse strings back into Duration. Supports locales, abbreviations, custom delimiters, and negative values.
use_when: When you need to display durations in a friendly format
When parsing duration strings from user input or configuration
avoid_when: When you need advanced time zone or calendar calculations
When you need to work with weeks or months as separate units
weaknesses: No support for weeks/months in pretty output
Limited to Duration, not full calendar dates
